blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Bureau of Immigration (BI) on Monday clarified that the Supreme Court’s (SC) decision directing the release of mining tycoon Joseph Sy does not constitute a determination of his citizenship. It explained that the case before the SC is an appeal in a habeas corpus petition involving Sy and “only involves questions on the legality of his detention, and not a determination on his citizenship.” Sy was arrested at the Ninoy Aquino International Airport last year upon arriving from Hong Kong.
